svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/spec_readme.py from sim/spec/*.yaml, sim/plant/spec.py and the code that loads the specs. Concept assumptions, not design values; the simulations they feed are synthetic (sim/README.md, evidence gate).

g.text: Terms: DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · SPEC-nnn = simulation parameter spec record (sim/spec/) · SSF-nnn = safety-significant software
function record (safety/software/) · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · SZ-nnn = actuator sizing study at level 2 (sim/mujoco/sizing.yaml)
